scope: Seek/read timing by OpenCV/FFmpeg decoder thread count on exact supplied 1080p sources

conditions.background: Nine-source AI26 inference process active; desktop load uncontrolled
conditions.pixel_comparison: Every thread setting matched the one-thread SHA-256 raw-pixel hash at each target
conditions.interpretation: Paired local diagnostic under shared load, not an isolated decoder guarantee

choice: Use two decoder threads as the bounded default for recorded sources. It improved paired medians on all three clips without relying on unrestricted default threading; the full-system comparison is recorded separately.
